claims.text: Sibling of ``_import_records`` and bound by the same contract: raw and unresolved, dependent on nothing but this one file, so it can run in a worker process while resolution stays in the parent.
claims.why: The claim depends on the implementation of _TypeWalk and its _visit method, which are not in this chunk. Without seeing those, we cannot verify they have no external dependencies.

claims.text: Units, raw import records AND type facts from a SINGLE ``ast.parse``.

claims.text: Unit order and unit CONTENT are identical to that function's -- the same ``_units_from_tree`` call on the same tree -- because the clone passes consume ``all_units`` positionally and no type record may reach them.
claims.why: The referenced function python_units_and_imports is not in this chunk, so we cannot verify the claim about identical behavior.
